cues: Some merozoites become male and female gametocytes instead.
A mosquito sucks them up with blood.
In its gut they become gametes and fuse: fertilisation happens in the mosquito.
The zygote burrows into the stomach wall as an oocyst, which bursts to release sporozoites.
They migrate to the salivary glands, ready for the next bite.
